summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community include updates on the integration with Spark, with a focus on the removal of Spark 3.4 support. Additionally, proposals for enhancing the specification and performance improvements for OSSFileIO are being actively discussed.
highlights: Iceberg Spark Community Sync notes detail integration updates
Proposal to add relative paths to v4 spec
Refactoring OSSFileIO to improve performance and fix bugs
Discussion on optimizing Parquet read path
